The structure of LaNiO3 crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with a unit cell containing 10 atoms—La2Ni2O6—distributed across three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows La centers in octahedral coordination by six O neighbors, while Ni centers have four O neighbors and O centers are five-coordinate with four La and one Ni. The La octahedra share corners and edges with one another, and corner- and edge-sharing also occurs between O-centered 5-vertex polyhedra. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component.
